title: 第 82章 准备回观第 81章 三甲竞秀杀印相生
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 石头的轮廓开始变化，先是头颅，然后是躯干，最后是四肢，可越到后面消耗越大，大到让他心里发慌。
他原本以为自己已经恢复满盈的灵气，怎么也该够用，可现实给了他狠狠一巴掌。
光是化一具拳头大小的人形，就把他榨得一滴都不剩了。
他硬着头皮继续输出，将最后一点灵气也挤了出来。
石头在他掌中终于完全化成了人形。
只有拳头大小，五官栩栩如生，眉眼之间颇有女师祖的神韵，连衣袍的褶皱都清晰可见。
他甚至还特意将道袍的领口和袖口纹路都化了出来。
因为他在动手之前，忽然想到一个极其严峻的问题：倘若只化肉身不化衣物，女师祖怕不是当场就要清理门户。
等到最后一缕衣袍褶皱化完，他双腿一软，直接跌坐在地，浑身灵气又一次空空如也。
掌心之上，端端正正地躺着一个拇指大小的人儿。
眉眼口鼻，衣袂裙裾，无一不与女师祖一模一样。
那小人通体莹白如玉，挽流云髻，眉目之间自有一股清冷之气。
只是体量极小，不过寸许，像是一件精致的玉雕。
女师祖飘近了些，低头打量这具为她准备的肉身，然后又抬头看了沈回一眼，幽幽地吐出两个字：
“就这？”
沈回脸上顿时有些挂不住了。
他方才说自己五行大成，可重塑肉身。
结果折腾半天，灵气耗尽，化出来的却是这么一个玩意儿。
早知道便先试一遍再召人出来了。
话说出去了，结果却办不到，脸被打的啪啪响。
他张了张嘴，想辩解两句，最后还是老老实实说了实话：
“失策了。这化物之法所需灵气甚多，我眼下修为不够……”
他顿了顿，补了一句，“恐怕要等结丹之后，丹田气海足够广阔，弟子才能真正为人重塑肉身。”
女师祖点了点头，倒也没有多说什么责备的话，只是道：
“那便等结丹再说。”
沈回松了口气，然后看向石头上那个迷你女师祖，犹豫了一下，道：
“那这个……弟子便烧了？”
女师祖看了他一眼，道：“弄都弄出来了，烧了岂不是浪费。”
说着也不等沈回答话，身形一晃，化作一缕青烟，径直朝那具拳头大的肉身钻了进去。
沈回只觉得掌心一痒，手中小人便活了过来。
她坐起身来，先摸了摸自己的胳膊，又抬手摸了摸自己的脸，那只小小的手掌贴在玉白色的面颊上，动作轻柔而细致。
接着她站起身，在他掌心上走了两步，步履稳健，与常人无异。
她仰头看了看沈回那张巨大的脸，又走到手掌边缘，低头看了一眼脚底的高度，随后若无其事地转身走了回去。
然后她盘膝坐下，开始打坐。
片刻之后，她睁开眼睛，向来清冷的面上罕见地露出了一丝惊喜。
“可以修行。”
她的声音极小极细，像是蚊蚋振翅，得竖起耳朵才听得清，“身形虽小，却五脏俱全。经脉周天运转无碍。”
沈回看着她，欲言又止。
他心里想的是，这个小小的肉身只有拳头大小，放在山野间走两步都怕被什么鸟雀叼了去。
可既然女师祖自己都不嫌弃，他也不好说什么。
他纠结的是另一件事：日后若是真给她塑造了正常的肉身，这个小的怎么办？
女师祖像是看穿了他的心思，抬起头来看着他，语气平淡如水：
“无妨。待你结丹之后，再杀我一次便是。左右不过是从头再来。”
沈回无言以对。
content_en:
The outline of the stone began to change, first the head, then the torso, and finally the limbs, but the consumption increased as it went to the back, so much that it made him feel panicked.
He originally thought that he had recovered enough spiritual energy, which should be enough, but reality slapped him hard.
Just taking the form of a fist-sized human squeezed him to the core.
He bit the bullet and continued to output, squeezing out the last bit of spiritual energy.
The stone finally completely transformed into a human form in his palm.
Only the size of a fist, her facial features are lifelike, her brows and eyes have the charm of a female master, and even the folds of her robe are clearly visible.
He even went so far as to make the collar and cuffs of the priest's robes textured.
Because before he took action, he suddenly thought of an extremely serious problem: If he only transformed into a body but not clothes, the female master might not have to clean up the house on the spot.
When the last wrinkles in his robe were gone, his legs softened and he fell directly to the ground, his whole body feeling empty again.
On the palm of his hand, there was a person the size of a thumb lying upright.
The facial features, eyes, mouth, nose, clothes and skirts are all exactly the same as those of the female master.
The little man's body is as white as jade, and he has a bun with flowing clouds in his hair. There is a cool air between his brows and eyes.
It's just that it's very small, no more than an inch, like an exquisite jade sculpture.
The female master floated closer, lowered her head to look at the body prepared for her, then raised her head to glance at Shen Hui, and faintly uttered two words:
"That's it?"
Shen Hui's face suddenly became a little uneasy.
He just said that he had perfected the Five Elements and could reshape his physical body.
As a result, after struggling for a long time, the spiritual energy was exhausted, and what came out was this thing.
If I had known earlier, I would have tried it before calling people out.
The words came out, but the result was that he couldn't do it, and his face was slapped.
He opened his mouth and wanted to make a few excuses, but finally told the truth honestly:
"It was a mistake. This method of transforming objects requires a lot of spiritual energy, and my current cultivation level is not enough..."
He paused and added, "I'm afraid that after the elixir is formed, the Dantian Qi sea is wide enough, so that the disciple can truly reshape the body for others."
The female master nodded, but did not say anything more to blame, she just said:
"Then we'll wait until the elixir is formed."
Shen Hui breathed a sigh of relief, then looked at the mini female master on the stone, hesitated, and said:
"Then this...disciple will be burned?"
The female master glanced at him and said, "It's all done, wouldn't it be a waste to burn it?"
Without waiting for Shen's reply, he swayed and turned into a wisp of smoke, which went straight into the fist-sized body.
Shen Hui felt an itch in his palm, and the little man in his hand came to life.
She sat up, first touched her arm, and then raised her hand to touch her face. Her small palm rested on her jade-white cheek, her movements gentle and delicate.
Then she stood up and took two steps on his palm, her steps steady, just like a normal person.
She looked up at Shen Hui's huge face, then walked to the edge of her palm, looked down at the height of her feet, then turned around and walked back as if nothing had happened.
Then she sat down cross-legged and began to meditate.
After a moment, she opened her eyes, a rare surprise showing on her usually cold face.
"You can practice."
Her voice was extremely small and thin, like the flapping of a gnat's wings. You had to prick up your ears to hear her clearly. "Although she is small, she has all five internal organs. Her meridians circulate around the sky without any hindrance."
Shen Hui looked at her and hesitated to speak.
What he was thinking was that this little body was only the size of a fist, and if he took even two steps in the mountains and fields, he would be afraid of being picked up by some bird.
But since the female master herself didn't dislike her, he couldn't say anything.
What he was struggling with was another thing: if he really gave her a normal body in the future, what would happen to this little one?
The female master seemed to have read through his thoughts, raised her head and looked at him, her tone was as calm as water:
"It doesn't matter. After you form the elixir, just kill me again. It's just starting from scratch."
Shen Hui was speechless.
